Latin word

corrumpō

corrumpō, corrumpere, corrūpī, corruptum

verb, third conjugation; with pecūniā, pretiō, dōnīs

bribe, buy over; spoil, ruin (food, goods, crops)

In this lexicon

  • bribe

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Off. 2.53: aliquem pecūniā (Lewis & Short); Traupman 193

  • damage

    also used · classical · Cato Agr. 3.2: nē corrumpātur; Plaut. Ps. 892: corrumpitur jam cēna
